sources.content: I built an internal reporting service in Python with FastAPI REST APIs, PostgreSQL storage, Pydantic request validation, and pytest tests. Business analysts used the service in production. I explained API tradeoffs to the analysts. I reduced nightly report refresh from 12 to 8 minutes by replacing repeated SQL scans with a shared aggregation query, measured on the same report workload over five nightly runs. This was elapsed runtime, not staff labor savings.
I maintained Java services and PostgreSQL queries for an internal inventory application. I added integration tests for order reconciliation.

jd.text: Required: Python, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, and production backend experience. Preferred: Kubernetes or Cloud Run. Responsibilities: automate reporting and explain technical tradeoffs to business users.
